title: Secure age verification.
intro: To protect minors, private messaging, personal requests, purchases and downloads are reserved for verified adults. It takes about two minutes and is only needed once.

s1.title: Have your ID ready
s1.body: A national identity card, passport or other supported government-issued document.

s2.title: Verify with our certified partner
s2.body: The partner checks the document's authenticity and confirms that it is really you.

s3.title: Return to the boutique
s3.body: We receive only the result — that you are 18 or older. Never your document images.

checking: Waiting for the result from our verification partner…
privacy: Verification is carried out by an independent identity verification provider on its own secure pages. MAISON LISA stores only the outcome, the date and a provider reference — no copies of documents and no biometric data. See our Privacy Policy for details.
devNote: Development mode: a labelled simulator replaces the identity provider

not_verified.title: Not yet verified
not_verified.body: Complete the verification to unlock messaging, requests and purchases.

pending.title: Verification in progress
pending.body: We are waiting for the result. This usually takes less than a minute.

verified.title: Verified adult
verified.body: Thank you. All features of the boutique are now available to you.

failed.title: Verification not successful
failed.body: We could not confirm that you are 18 or older. You may try again with a valid document.

manual_review.title: Under review
manual_review.body: Our verification partner is reviewing your documents manually. We will notify you once a decision is made.

expired.title: Verification expired
expired.body: Your verification has expired. Please verify again to continue.

revoked.title: Verification revoked
revoked.body: Your verification was revoked. Please contact us if you believe this is an error.
